objectives.title: Collect Doubloons
objectives.description: Attack Treasure Chests and Mercenaries to collect Doubloons.

objectives.title: Turn in Doubloons
objectives.description: Hand your Doubloons over to Blackheart or you will drop them all when you die!

objectives.title: Bombard your Enemies
objectives.description: After receiving enough Doubloons from your team, Blackheart will bombard your enemy's Structures!
